info.name: SuprSend Broadcast Ws Signing Key API

request.description:
Roll a signing key. Generates a new signing key that replaces the existing active key. The previous key is marked `rolled`.

The new `private_key_pem` and `private_key_base64` are returned **only once** in this response - store them securely.

response.name: Signing key rolled. A new signing key is created and its private key material is returned once.

request.description:
Create a signing key for this workspace.

The `private_key_pem` and `private_key_base64` fields are returned **only once** at creation. Store them securely - they cannot be retrieved later.

Only **one active** signing key is allowed per workspace. To replace an existing active key, use the [Roll Workspace Signing Key](#operation/roll-workspace-signing-key) endpoint instead.

response.name: Signing key created. Private key material is returned once in this response.
